three electrons and one H2O packet born on the lower-foil face over [tau, end] and one electron collected at the upper foil: conductor -> free -> conductor charge, flows record (native v6 rules), closures, second step
newborn refusals: start inside metal, velocity into the metal, foil corner, charged interior newborn (no source path), no remaining flight, unknown ID
external loads: thermal delta = Joule + loads (exactly once), ledger updated; replayed sequence, duplicate and shared energy owner refused
an external Joule load (channel or energy owner) and a Hall-reserved producer are refused typed: Joule is counted once

heat-engine extremes are typed scoped refusals before the engine (1e181 J, 5e21-molecule-scale load, net heating above room, nonfinite) or typed engine refusals (concentrated load); no abort, owner unchanged
declared heat-only source patches leave temperatures bit-identical; the material/configuration identities change
save/restore after a collection step restores the banks and the kinetic ledgers
